articles.title: Russia's massive hypersonic missile attack on Ukraine leaves at least 22 dead and dozens injured
articles.summary: Russia launched its largest hypersonic missile attack against Ukraine, resulting in at least 22 deaths, including children, and over 100 injuries. This relentless bombardment signifies a major escalation in the ongoing conflict, employing advanced weaponry. articles.title: Plans for ‘floating city’ that would carry 80,000 people dwarfing the finest cruise ships in the world
articles.summary: Plans are reportedly emerging for a massive floating city designed to accommodate 80,000 people, dwarfing current cruise ships. This ambitious concept highlights future urbanisation solutions, potentially addressing challenges like land scarcity and rising sea levels through innovative engineering. Such a project would necessitate significant technological advancements and sustainable design, marking a new frontier for human habitation in marine environments.

articles.title: Trump Administration Accelerates US-China Critical Minerals Decoupling as Pentagon’s 2027 Defense Deadline Reshapes a $30 Billion Magnet Market
articles.summary: China's upcoming April 2025 export licensing for seven critical rare earth elements and high-performance magnets will significantly impact Western defense, automotive, and electronics supply chains. This strategic move highlights global dependence on China for these essential materials, compelling nations to explore diversification and strengthen their domestic production capabilities to ensure supply security and strategic autonomy in key industries.
